correctness.rationale: The exact 12-vertex graph contains 20 edges; two genuinely different exhaustive enumerations (least-unmatched-vertex recursion and all 38,760 six-edge subsets) agree on its 32 perfect matchings. These yield 1,196 simplices with f-vector (20,142,392,418,192,32). A saved 526-pair certificate is replayed with each unique-codimension-one-coface check, leaving a 2-complex with f-vector (18,66,60). A spanning tree has 17 edges; its 49 non-tree generators are killed one by one by 49 exact single-letter triangle attaching relations, proving pi_1=1 beyond abelianization. Euler characteristic 12 and integral freeness imply H_2=Z^11; Hurewicz plus Whitehead yield the asserted wedge of two-spheres. Four exact modular boundary ranks all equal 49. No infinite claim is made.

value.rationale: The length-four cyclic column boundary is the first natural square-cylinder analogue of the new open 3×2n perfect-matching-complex classification. Three added wrap-around edges change the known open 3×4 case from S^1 to an 11-fold S^2 wedge. This explains a mathematically meaningful boundary sensitivity in a natural graph family and provides a full attaching-map homotopy benchmark for future periodic studies; it is not a trivial normalization check or a recomputation of a known table. The graph is simultaneously the smallest elongated three-dimensional 2×2×3 cubical box.
